rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for organizing something or making arrangements.

example.traditional: 我幫你安排好個旅行行程。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 on1 paai4 hou2 go3 leoi5 hang4 hong4 cing4

rows.note: Use this when putting items, steps, or things into a particular order.

example.english: Arrange the documents first, and I'll look at them later.
example.traditional: 你先排好啲文件，等陣我再睇。
example.jyutping: nei5 sin1 paai4 hou2 di1 man4 gin6 dang2 zan6 ngo5 zoi3 tai2

rows.note: Use this when people have arranged and agreed to meet at a time or place.

example.english: We arrange to meet in Causeway Bay on Saturday.
example.traditional: 我哋已經約好星期六喺銅鑼灣見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 joek3 hou2 sing1 kei4 luk6 hai2 tung4 lo4 waan1 gin3

rows.note: Use this when arranging means preparing something in advance, rather than making the overall arrangements.

example.english: Prepare the report so we can arrange the meeting.
example.traditional: 你準備好份報告，我哋先可以安排開會。
example.jyutping: nei5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 on1 paai4 hoi1 wui2
